regime.label: Cautious rebound
regime.note: The S&P 500 rose about 2.5% and the Nasdaq about 2.3% last week, and chip stocks bounced about 8%. But October CPI rose 0.4%, ahead of forecasts, the 10-year yield climbed to about 5.15%, futures price a December Fed hike as nearly certain, and Bitcoin fell about 10%. Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO. This week: Nvidia earnings Tuesday, Palo Alto Wednesday, Walmart Thursday, plus Home Depot, Target and Disney. Retail sales are out Tuesday, Fed minutes Wednesday, and the Anthropic IPO reportedly prices around Nov 18.
